parameters.inputs: (ait_product_subscription/any(s: s/_ait_subscriberid_value eq @{variables('Subscriber')?['ait_subscriberid']}) or ait_pack_product/any(p: p/ait_isactive eq true and p/ait_pack_subscription/any(s: s/_ait_subscriberid_value eq @{variables('Subscriber')?['ait_subscriberid']})))

parameters.where: @and(equals(item()?['kind'], 'product'), or(equals(item()?['name'], items('Each_token')), equals(item()?['alt'], items('Each_token')), contains(item()?['aliases'], concat(',', items('Each_token'), ','))))

parameters.inputs: @if(greater(length(body('Pack_hit')), 0), first(body('Pack_hit')), if(greater(length(body('Exact_hit')), 0), first(body('Exact_hit')), if(equals(length(body('Contains_hit')), 1), first(body('Contains_hit')), json(concat('{"kind":"', if(greater(length(body('Contains_hit')), 1), 'ambiguous', 'none'), '"}')))))

inputs: @{if(empty(body('Removed_labels')), if(outputs('Is_all'), 'You had no subscriptions.', ''), concat('Removed: ', join(body('Removed_labels'), ', '), '.'))}

@{if(or(outputs('Is_all'), empty(variables('Unmatched'))), '', concat('You do not follow ''', join(variables('Unmatched'), ''', '''), ''' directly. A product that comes with a pack can only be removed with its pack. Type /mysubs to see what you follow.'))}
@{if(empty(variables('Ambiguous')), '', concat('More than one of your subscriptions matches ''', join(variables('Ambiguous'), ''', '''), '''. Pick one below.'))}

@{if(equals(length(body('Count_now')?['value']), 0), 'You follow no products now, so no digests will be sent. Type /packs or /products to start again.', concat('You follow ', length(body('Count_now')?['value']), ' products now.'))}
